recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, maximalist digital collage featuring a central figure on an airplane staircase, surrounded by a surreal assembly of tropical flora, exotic animals, and celestial objects against a magenta-to-purple gradient sky and a large commercial jet.
coreVisualRelationships: Central human figure as the focal point on a symmetrical staircase
Large-scale airplane fuselage acting as a horizontal backdrop
Juxtaposition of wild animals (tiger, elephant) with domestic travel elements
Vibrant magenta sky contrasting with the cool teal of the water
coreInvariants: Magenta and purple gradient sky with stylized white clouds
A large commercial jet with a rainbow-gradient stripe
Symmetrical staircase leading from the bottom center upward
Eclectic mix of palm trees, cacti, and exotic creatures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A man in white attire stands centrally on a metal staircase, occupying the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The metal staircase provides a strong geometric base and leading line from the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central figure, move up to the large arched title, then sweep outward to the animals and the airplane in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and maximalist, with the sky providing the only breathing room at the top corners.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Teal and green (water and tropical foliage)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow and orange (secondary text and tiger fur)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout, with high-value whites in the clothing and clouds to create pop.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Bold, expressive sans-serif with organic, hand-drawn edges
letterConstructionRules: Arched baseline for the primary title
Irregular, slightly wobbly stroke widths suggesting brushwork
Angled terminals and non-uniform character heights
Secondary text follows the curve of the primary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a wide, expressive leg
The 'C' is deeply curved and open
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, white, arched display title paired with a smaller, high-contrast yellow sub-headline following the same curve.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar bold, playful energy and weight
To capture the irregular, hand-painted edges

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a surreal collage: a magenta and purple gradient sky with fluffy white clouds, a large commercial jet with a rainbow stripe, a man in white on a metal staircase, surrounded by a tiger, elephants, palm trees, and a dragon statue over teal water.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a bold, white, hand-drawn arched style at the top. Add the secondary name in a smaller, bright yellow font following the curve immediately below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the sky a vibrant magenta-purple gradient?
Is the main text arched and hand-drawn in appearance?
Are the collage elements layered with a mix of scales?
Is the central figure on a staircase the clear focal point?

adjustableVariables: Specific animal species in the collage
Degree of arch in the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the central figure
Exact airline logos or branding on the jet
Specific artist names or trademarked titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the tiger and elephants are integrated into the water/ground plane.
Check that the text arch is symmetrical and centered.
Verify the rainbow stripe on the plane has a smooth gradient.
Confirm the central figure's white clothing pops against the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surreal Collage + Magenta Sky + Arched Hand-Drawn Type + Tropical/Jetset Theme
